text: Claire has invited us to her housewarming on Saturday at 7pm. She said not to bring anything, but I'll take a bottle of red anyway.
Aneesh passed his driving test this morning, first attempt! His dad was more nervous than he was.
Delroy's daughter starts reception on September 4th. He's already dreading the school run.
Fang mentioned she's vegan now, so no cheeseboard when she comes round.
Remind me to text Marta good luck before her piano audition on Thursday at 2pm. She's been practising every night and sounds really anxious about it.

Olga's graduation is June 14th at 11am in the cathedral. Her parents are flying over from Kraków for it, and her boyfriend Pedro is driving them up from Heathrow the night before. She's worried the gown won't arrive in time because the university messed up her order. There's a family dinner afterwards at 7 and she asked if I'd join them, which I'd love to.

Haruto and his wife are hosting a dinner on the 12th at half 7 to celebrate their daughter getting into Cambridge. It's going to be quite a crowd, about fourteen people, including his brother from Osaka who's visiting that week. His wife doesn't eat shellfish, and Haruto said their daughter is gluten free now. I'm bringing dessert, so I should find a decent flourless chocolate cake recipe by the weekend.
Beatriz got her A level results today. Two A*s and a B, so she's off to Leeds for medicine.
Need to buy a card for Lola's son Finn. He finished his GCSEs last week and they're having a little party for him on Sunday afternoon.
Nikhil's engagement party has been cancelled. He and Priya split up over the summer, and he sounded pretty low on the phone.
Bethany is retaking her theory test on 11/3 at 9am. She failed by two points last time.
Dawit says his little boy Samir lost his first tooth at breakfast. Apparently the tooth fairy is paying a pound now.

Ali's leaving do is Friday at 6 at the Crown. He's finally off to the new job in Glasgow after eleven years with us, and he starts there on the 3rd. Everyone is chipping in for a present, and Bridget is collecting the money until Wednesday lunchtime. I said I'd go for one drink. I should put twenty quid in and sign the card tomorrow morning.
Bridget keeps hinting that she'd love one of those Le Creuset casserole dishes. Worth remembering for Christmas.
Oscar has his grade 5 trumpet exam on May 20th. Ask him how it went the following weekend.
Sara's twins, Ibrahim and Miriam, start secondary school next Wednesday. She's dropping them off together and then going straight to work.
Pick up the dry cleaning before 5pm tomorrow, and the suit needs to be ready for Saturday.
Joe from work is doing his master's part time at Birkbeck. He has exams in January and is already stressed about the dissertation.
Mandla and Naledi are celebrating ten years married on April 9th. They're doing a big lunch at her mum's place, and we're invited.
Don't forget Lin's thesis defence is on the 2nd at 10am. I should send her a message the night before.
Dafydd is a huge rugby fan and supports the Scarlets. Never mention Ospreys around him.
Aaliyah's mum had her hip operation yesterday morning. Aaliyah is staying with her for the week, so I should check in on Friday.
Pedro got into the national youth orchestra! He found out on Tuesday afternoon. Must send him a proper congratulations.
Jin's daughter has her ballet recital on June 3rd at 6:30. Jin asked if we could come and I said yes.
Isaac and Claire are having a joint birthday barbecue on 7/18 from 2pm. Bring the folding chairs.

Long chat with Marta Kowalski after the parents' evening. Her eldest, Oscar, has his eleven plus on September 12th and the whole family is on edge. She's hired a tutor for Tuesday and Thursday evenings, and he's apparently doing fine with the maths but struggling with the verbal reasoning. Her husband thinks they're pushing him too hard. I should drop round with some of Lola's old practice papers this weekend.
Fang said her brother James is graduating from Edinburgh on July 1st. She's flying up the night before.
Driving test booked for March 22nd at 8:40am. Need to do at least four more lessons before then.
Delroy Shah is turning fifty on the 28th. His wife is planning a surprise dinner at that Italian place on Friday at 8pm and asked me to keep him busy until then.
Haruto mentioned his son got the lead in the school play. It runs December 5th to 7th.
Called Beatriz to see how the housewarming went. Lots of people came, but the neighbours complained about the noise around midnight.
Bethany's dog Biscuit had to have his leg operated on this morning. She's absolutely beside herself.
Nikhil's sister Aaliyah has her bar exam results out on November 10th. I need to remember to ask him how she did.
Ibrahim has been accepted into Manchester for engineering! His mum Sara is over the moon.

Coffee with Miriam this afternoon. She is training to be a midwife and loves it, though the night shifts are rough. Her finals are on May 14th and 15th, both at 9am, and she's doing a placement at the Royal Free until then. Her partner Joe has been doing all the cooking so she can revise.
Ali and his partner are throwing a christening party for their baby on Sunday, May 4th at 1pm. Ask Ali if they need help with the food.
Olga's dinner party on Saturday is off because her husband has Covid. She said they'll rebook for the 15th instead.
Note to self: Joe likes single malt and has started collecting vinyl. Good gift ideas.

Mandla's youngest started nursery this morning. Apparently she cried for ten minutes and then didn't want to go home at 3pm. His older boy, Dawit, is in Year 6 now and has his SATs in May, which Mandla seems more worried about than Dawit is. Naledi has gone back to work full time, so Mandla is doing all the pickups on Mondays and Fridays.
I'm hosting book club on Thursday at 7:30. Need to get snacks and tidy the living room.
Dafydd's audition for the Welsh National Opera chorus is on the 19th at 11am. He's terrified, so I should text him that morning.
Lin and her husband have just moved to Bristol. Their housewarming is on 10/25, an afternoon thing from 3 till late.

Isaac's daughter Lola passed her grade 8 violin with distinction. He sent me the certificate and he was clearly so proud. She's now auditioning for the Royal Northern College of Music on February 11th at 2:15pm, and she's already a bundle of nerves about it. Isaac says she practises four hours a day and barely sleeps. Remind me to send her a good luck card the week before.
Spoke to Samir about his son's first day at uni. Apparently he's settled in fine and has already joined the climbing club.
Bridget's niece has her first driving test on June 9th at 10:15. Bridget is giving her extra practice every Sunday morning in the Tesco car park.

Pedro invited me to his fortieth on August 23rd. It's at a vineyard in Kent, and there's a minibus leaving London Bridge at noon and coming back around 11pm. His wife Beatriz is organising most of it and mentioned he's been after a decent coffee grinder for ages. I said I'd confirm by the end of the week, so I need to check whether I'm back from Lisbon by then.
Must ring Claire tomorrow evening and ask how Finn's mock exams went.
Jin Nakamura is the new head of maths at the school. She starts after half term and is a bit nervous about managing the department.
Aneesh's parents are throwing him a graduation dinner on 6/27 at 7. He asked me to give a short speech, which I've agreed to.
Nothing much from the parents' meeting tonight. Mostly about the new uniform policy.
Delroy says his son Isaac failed his driving test on Monday at 9am. He's gutted and doesn't want to talk about it. I should give it a week, then maybe take him out for a practice drive.

Lunch with Beatriz Gonzalez and her partner Naledi. They're getting married next spring, probably April 26th, and want a small do in Lisbon with maybe thirty guests. Naledi's dad hasn't been well, so they're keeping it close to dates when he can travel. Beatriz, or Bea as everyone calls her, asked me to be a witness, which was lovely.
Ibrahim has his black belt grading on the 8th at 10am. His mum says he's been training every day after school.
Haruto's mum turns ninety on February 2nd. The family's planning a lunch at noon and he asked if I can make the cake.
Book the restaurant for Saturday at 8 and confirm the table for six.
Finn has finally passed his driving theory! It took him three goes. Don't forget to congratulate him when I see him Sunday.
Ran into Oscar at the station. He's started an apprenticeship at an engineering firm in Reading and seems really happy there.

Sara Kaur told me her daughter's school prom is on July 10th at 6pm. Sara is making the dress herself and has been up past midnight sewing. Her husband is in charge of the limo. Remind me to ask for photos afterwards.
Naledi's brother Dawit has his citizenship test on Tuesday morning. He's done all the practice questions but is still panicking. I said I'd quiz him over the phone on Monday at 8pm.
Miriam's cat Pepper went missing last night. She's put posters up all round the estate. Need to share her post on the neighbourhood group.
